name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.17 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
